documented_return: An object of class ggchord_layout_export. Selected component names contain data frames. Circular layouts additionally contain an annotation_registry data frame. Its inner rows expose the physical track, radial width and boundaries; outer rows expose region, sector, annotation class, dominant and actual band, spill reason, leader-crossing count, slot, bounding box and leader corridor. The metadata member records rotation, aspect ratio, limits, coordinate units and transformation state. Collinear layouts instead include sequence_layout, containing each sequence's horizontal range, backbone y, orientation, units per bp, reversible x offset, anchor and source origin. orientation_diagnostics records directional support, confidence and unresolved cases. Position lanes remain local offsets and are not circular physical tracks. Their label_diagnostics records placed or hidden labels after shared linear collision handling, including source layer, row, reason and leader collisions. connection_report records retained and omitted ribbon input rows with a selection reason. When converted inputs are present, conversion_reports retains their conversion attributes, including source class, column renaming, sequence information and object metadata. Sequence break marks are included under seq. Segmented linear displays retain one sequence_layout row per window, including row_id, segment order, break flags and display gap_bp. Source accession, origin/end/full length, local orientation, x offset and units per bp describe each reversible piece; gaps have no source mapping. Automatic segment break paths have .decoration = "segment_break" in the sequence geometry. gap_bp is display spacing, not omitted length. Quantitative geometry is selected with track; track_registry records each ID/sequence band, source layers, numerical limits, unit and physical measurement status. track_diagnostics records retained/missing/clipped source rows. Numerical track axes and explicit bp reference bars are included under axis; axis_selection records selected sequence axes. Explicit label shrinking adds label_fit_diagnostics, preserving original text, requested/minimum/final sizes and fallback or hiding reasons. render_context distinguishes layout-only estimates from actual panel measurements. For a target-size measured report use diagnose_ggchord().
